Platform capabilities

Everything a team needs to ship with confidence

Each capability stands on its own, and together they cover the full path from first draft to a reviewed, released change.

  • Review

    Automated review gates

    Define the checks that matter once, then let routine approvals resolve themselves before they reach a person.

  • Collaboration

    Shared draft history

    Every revision is recorded with its author and timestamp, so the team can trace how a change took shape.

  • Insights

    Live delivery signals

    Watch throughput, queue depth, and cycle time update as work moves, without exporting a single report.

  • Governance

    Policy and access control

    Set permissions per workspace and project, with data retention and residency that scale to your obligations.

How it works

Go from sign-up to first result in three steps

A short, ordered path. Each step builds on the one before it, so the sequence reads top to bottom on any screen.

  1. 1

    Connect your workspace

    Link the tools your team already uses. Read-only access is enough to get started, and you can widen scopes later.

  2. 2

    Set your guardrails

    Choose the rules that matter to you. Defaults are sensible, so most teams keep them and move on.

  3. 3

    Review your first result

    Within minutes you get a summary you can act on. Share it, refine the inputs, or schedule it to run on its own.

Frequently asked

Answers to the questions teams ask before getting started

Most teams complete initial setup in a single afternoon. You connect your data sources, invite your collaborators, and the default workspace is ready to use immediately. Larger rollouts with custom roles typically finish within the first week.

Yes. Guided importers cover the most common spreadsheet and database formats, and a flexible field mapper lets you align your existing structure to the workspace schema. Historical records are preserved with their original timestamps so nothing is lost in the move.

Data is encrypted both in transit and at rest, access is governed by granular role-based permissions, and every administrative action is captured in an immutable audit log. You control where your workspace is hosted and can export or delete your records at any time.

You are notified well before reaching any threshold, and your work is never interrupted. From the same notice you can upgrade in place or schedule a call to review the right plan for your growth. There are no surprise charges and no forced overages.

Every account includes guided onboarding with templates, in-product walkthroughs, and a searchable help center. Teams on annual plans are paired with a dedicated specialist for the first ninety days to make sure the rollout lands smoothly.
